title: New European Fees Hit Shein's Cheap Fashion

source.author: FashionUnited
source.title: Shein warns of slow European recovery as EU import fees cut sales
source.note: Single source; FashionUnited attributes the figures to Reuters and marks the article as written with the assistance of AI. Percentage changes whose comparison period the source does not state (Europe -27.6%, US -9.4%, group -6%, marketing -41.5%, rest of world +18%) are left out; only the direction and the dollar amounts are used. The 17% rise in operating income is stated as year-on-year. 'Operating income' rendered as 'operating profit'; 'critical' as 'crucial'; 'cautious' as 'careful'.

figures.text: Shein expects Europe under pressure until second half of 2027
figures.quote: Shein expects its European business to stay under pressure until the second half of 2027

figures.text: new EU fees on e-commerce imports cut sales in the region in the third quarter; source: Reuters
figures.quote: after new EU fees on e-commerce imports cut sales in the region by more than a quarter in the third quarter, according to press agency Reuters

figures.text: Europe revenue fell to $2.98 billion; newly listed company raised prices to offset extra costs
figures.quote: Revenue in Europe fell 27.6 percent to 2.98 billion dollars, after the newly listed company raised prices to offset the extra costs.

figures.text: first results to show effect of EU three-euro fee
figures.quote: The results are the first to show the effect of the European Union's three-euro fee on e-commerce imports.

figures.text: US decline; group revenue down to $10.27 billion
figures.quote: Weaker European sales and a 9.4 percent decline in the US pulled group revenue down 6 percent to 10.27 billion dollars.

figures.text: CEO Sky Xu quote on call with analysts
figures.quote: "We expect the EU to remain under pressure for the next few quarters," chief executive Sky Xu said on a call with analysts.

figures.text: European sales might not recover until most deliveries come from European warehouses; Shein is investing in them
figures.quote: Xu said European sales might not recover until most deliveries are made from European warehouses, which the company is investing in.

figures.text: further two-euro fee at start of November; uncertain year-end season
figures.quote: The EU added a further two-euro fee on e-commerce parcels at the start of November, which leaves Shein facing an uncertain year-end shopping season.

figures.text: fees per type of item; five different items could cost 25 euros
figures.quote: The fees apply to each type of item in a shipment, so an order with five different items could cost 25 euros in customs fees.

figures.text: business built on five-euro dresses and ten-euro shoes
figures.quote: Shein built its business on five-euro dresses and ten-euro shoes.

figures.text: fast growth pushed up price competition for rivals H&M and Zara
figures.quote: Shein's fast growth helped push up price competition for rivals such as H&M and Zara.

figures.text: growth stalled since US and Europe ended duty-free access for e-commerce imports
figures.quote: That growth has stalled since the US and Europe ended duty-free access for e-commerce imports.

figures.text: cut marketing spending in the quarter, mostly online advertising, to protect profitability
figures.quote: Shein cut marketing spending by 41.5 percent in the quarter, mostly online advertising, to protect profitability.

figures.text: operating income +17% year-on-year to $743 million while revenue fell
figures.quote: Operating income rose 17 percent year-on-year to 743 million dollars while revenue fell

figures.text: growing quickly in other regions, especially Latin America; less dependent on Europe and US
figures.quote: Xu said Shein was growing quickly in other regions, especially Latin America, which makes it less dependent on Europe and the US.
Revenue from the rest of the world rose 18 percent to 4.2 billion dollars.

figures.text: consumers more cautious; value for money still critical
figures.quote: "Consumers around the world are becoming more cautious," Xu said, adding that offering value for money was still critical.
